cards.title: Relativas con: qué expresa
cards.lede: Ya colocas preposiciones al final o antes del relativo en estilo formal.

rows.value: The man I was talking to · posición natural conversacional
The man to whom I was speaking · registro formal escrito
I have three brothers, two of whom live in London.
The author in whose books I am interested · pertenencia formal

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: Sujeto + (who/that/which) + S + V + preposición · The candidate (who) we voted for won.
Sujeto + preposición + whom/which + S + V · The candidate for whom we voted won.
Sujeto, cuantificador + of + whom/which + V · They interviewed ten applicants, three of whom were hired.
There were several proposals, none of which were accepted. · quantifier neg

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: The research field to which she dedicated her entire career has advanced rapidly.
We discussed several potential solutions, none of which proved to be cost-effective.
She introduced me to her colleagues, most of whom had years of industry experience.
The company with which we signed the contract has offices across Europe.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Posición Informal / Hablada
columns.rule: La preposición queda atrapada al final de la cláusula; admite omitir el pronombre.
examples: That's the company I worked for.

columns.label: Posición Formal / Académica
columns.rule: La preposición encabeza la cláusula seguida imperativamente de 'whom' (personas) o 'which' (cosas).
examples: That is the company for which I worked.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: The committee member to who I sent the file was absent.
The committee member to whom I sent the file was absent. / The member who I sent the file to was absent.
lines.note: si la preposición precede directamente al pronombre relativo referido a personas, se debe usar 'whom', no 'who'

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: Tras una preposición NUNCA se usa 'who' ni 'that', solo 'whom' (with whom, about whom).
Usa 'which' para objetos o instituciones (in which, to which).
some of whom, all of which, half of whom, neither of which.

rows.key: Omitir el pronombre en uso informal
rows.value: En el habla cotidiana puedes omitir 'who/that' si la preposición va al final.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: He manages a team of twelve engineers, all of ___ hold master's degrees.
quiz.explain: Tras la preposición 'of' referida a personas en un cuantificador se utiliza obligatoriamente 'whom'.

quiz.q: The hotel at ___ we stayed during our trip to Florence was built in the 18th century.
quiz.explain: Tras una preposición directa referida a un edificio o cosa ('at...'), el pronombre adecuado es 'which'.

quiz.q: She had dozens of books on her shelves, many of ___ she had never actually read.
quiz.explain: Cuantificador referido a objetos inanimados ('books') → 'many of which'.
